posts.text:
Autonomous, uncut, 1x speed. This is GR00T 2 controlling real dexterous hands to perform a chemistry lab experiment (and clean up after itself) end to end.

Episode 1 of a new series! I’ll keep dropping real-time robot videos, with none of the “4x” or “8x” labels you usually see
